miniz 3.1.0, https://github.com/richgel999/miniz/tree/3.1.0

miniz_tinfl.c, miniz_tdef.c and miniz.c provide bounded zlib decompression
and recompression for the explicit native IconGUID edit.
Upstream files are unmodified. miniz_export.h replaces CMake's generated header
for this static build. See LICENSE for the upstream license.
